1.consolidated_definition: Juego de niños que consiste en tirar monedas hacia arriba cara o cruz; pierde el que va tirando si caen caras hacia abajo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Game of children in which coins are tossed upwards showing heads or tails; the one who continues to toss loses if they land on heads facing downwards.
